title: PSSM Split shadows cause AMD GPU driver crash when using stretched aspect ratio in the embedded game window
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in: v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0] and later snapshots
-Not reproducible in v4.4.beta1.official [d33da79d3] and earlier snapshots

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - Driver Version 24.12.1

### Issue description

When using the "Embedded game size stretches to fit the Game Workspace" button introduced in v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0], PSSM shadows cause a AMD GPU driver crash.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3eeca57a-0384-4f88-9bf4-e37955603d65)

Switching to "Keep the aspect ratio of the embedded game." causes PSSM shadows to not crash the game.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dd3130e-9425-4fdb-b026-5ae96b4d1e30)

### Steps to reproduce

-Download and import  majikayogames's SimpleFPSController (https://github.com/majikayogames/SimpleFPSController) on any version 4.4beta2 or later

-In DirectionalLight3D make sure PSSM 4 Split or PSSM 2 Split shadows are selected (they are on by default in the majikayogames's source).

-Run the project (F5)

-After loading in quickly press the "Embedded game size stretches to fit the Game Workspace." button.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f63c9fc6-4615-4f5e-b6cd-66ef9c1b0247)

-Then, quickly turn and move to the left and [look at the shadows cast by the buildings](https://imgur.com/a/4LAYYev).

-Your monitors will go black for anywhere between 15 seconds to a minute and then your monitors will come back on and you will have a AMD GPU driver error.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/majikayogames/SimpleFPSController

But I think that any project with many PSSM shadows would cause a crash if you use the ["Embedded game size stretches to fit the Game Workspace."](https://i.imgur.com/UACyjkQ.png) button
